title: Oracle: Author tests/harness/test_claudecap_parallel_isolation.py regression tests for parallel isolation
acceptance_criteria: The test file tests/harness/test_claudecap_parallel_isolation.py is authored and contains >= 10 non-vacuous tests.
Asserts that `claude_parallel_cap=4` + disjoint tasks -> parallel branch chosen.
Asserts that `claude_parallel_cap=1` -> sequential branch chosen (second task suspended/serialized).
Asserts that overlapping tasks are serialized.
Asserts that headless claude worker env contains a distinct `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`.
Asserts that gemini/agy worker env does not contain `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`.
Passes with exit code 0 when run against an implemented orchestrator/daemon: python -m pytest tests/harness/test_claudecap_parallel_isolation.py -q

spec.objective: Author unit tests validating that the configurable Claude parallel cap and per-worker config directory isolation logic behave correctly under various settings, and assert fail-safe, default-off, and backwards-compatible behavior.
functional_requirements: Verify that when `claude_parallel_cap` is set to 4 and multiple tasks with disjoint files are dispatched, the dispatcher spawns them concurrently on the parallel branch without suspending them.
Verify that when `claude_parallel_cap` is set to 1, the dispatcher executes tasks sequentially and suspends running workers.
Verify that tasks with overlapping files are still serialized (veto holds via decides/parallelism checks).
Verify that the Claude headless worker environment gets a distinct per-task config directory derived from work_dir.
Verify that the Gemini/Agy worker environment is unchanged by the Claude parallel isolation logic.
edge_cases: test_claude_parallel_cap_4_disjoint_tasks_run_concurrently: cap=4 with two disjoint-files claude tasks dispatch via the parallel branch (no mutual SIGSTOP).
test_headless_claude_env_gets_distinct_config_dir: each claude worker env gets a distinct per-task CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; gemini/agy env unchanged.
non_goals: An integration shim, an integration-level e2e harness, or a live-concurrency integration test is explicitly out of scope.
spec.implementation_notes: Create tests/harness/test_claudecap_parallel_isolation.py, importing pytest, autowork_daemon, and orchestrator, stubbing out os/shutil effects and load_config.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: No external test data. Stubs directory structure and load_config.

token_budget_ratio.note: Pure test authoring task, implementation is in the next task.
